reasoning_content:
Wait — I deleted the xplan.xml file. Let me check again: the inspireplu workspace shows "no xplan.xml" — let me verify. Actually the guide lists `<DEEGREE_WORKSPACE_ROOT>/xplan-webservices-inspireplu-workspace/jdbc/inspireplu.xml` — so the inspireplu workspace has inspireplu.xml, not xplan.xml. That's fine.

Alright, let's restart the three Tomcat instances.

action.command:
unset CATALINA_PID
source /etc/xplanbox.env
CATALINA_PID=/opt/tomcat-dienste/tomcat.pid /opt/tomcat-dienste/bin/startup.sh
sleep 3
CATALINA_PID=/opt/tomcat-anwendung/tomcat.pid /opt/tomcat-anwendung/bin/startup.sh
sleep 3
CATALINA_PID=/opt/tomcat-api/tomcat.pid /opt/tomcat-api/bin/startup.sh
sleep 10
ps aux | grep "[c]atalina.home" | awk '{print $2}' | while read p; do tr '\0' ' ' < /proc/$p/cmdline | grep -o "catalina.base=[^ ]*" | sed "s/^/pid $p: /"; done

tool_call.name: terminal
tool_call.arguments:
